title: C# Beginner Mock Test 2
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for C# at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of .NET SDK?

options.text: use dotnet build to obtain compiler evidence
the SDK includes build run and test tools
a runtime-only installation may not include build tools
The runtime automatically repairs invalid state

questions.explanation: use dotnet build to obtain compiler evidence. Verify with nullable analysis, compiler diagnostics, and a focused test.
